items.name: Italy
items.description: Terraced coastlines in the south, lake villas in the north, and cypress roads in between. Italy rewards travellers who leave space in the day for a second coffee.
items.bestSeason: April to June, September to October

items.name: Switzerland
items.description: The most precise travel in Europe: trains that meet the lake boats, trails that start at the platform, and air you notice on the first morning.
items.bestSeason: June to September, December to March for snow

items.name: France
items.description: Paris for the museums and the long lunches, Provence for lavender roads and stone farmhouses, and both for the way an afternoon can simply be spent at a table.

items.name: Greece
items.description: Whitewashed villages, water in shades you will try to describe and fail, and tavernas where the fish arrived that morning. Best in the shoulder weeks.
items.bestSeason: May to June, September to early October

items.name: Austria
items.description: Lake villages with a church spire, mountain roads that end in a cable car, and coffee houses built for an unhurried hour. Quieter than its neighbours, and all the better for it.

items.name: Spain
items.description: Andalusian hill towns, orange trees in small plazas and a late dinner culture that takes some getting used to and then ruins you for everywhere else.
items.bestSeason: March to May, October to November
